answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a slashable bond, so influence is bought with locked capital instead of free accounts. Clones are exposed by a plume of correlated signals: shared funding, synchronized timing, mirrored code. When several identities collapse to one operator, their bonds are burned. An attacker wanting a thousand votes must lock a thousand bonds, and the whole mesa of fakes becomes a sunk cost once the correlation plume is spotted. Not even a quartz vault hides the common payout trail.
